scope: Clearance entry/sweep resume preflight-to-operation-start lane journal consistency.
finding: Preflight required a matching 13-field lane journal, but commit only rechecked common order/generation, visit context and roster. A different/disappeared journal could pass the commit and fail later ADOPT after startup had consumed the durable order.
executionContext: Normal discovery and remoteExecCall callers are unscheduled; no ordinary intra-call suspension is claimed for them. The public script call also supports scheduled execution, where preflight can precede a scheduler suspension and delivery/update before the later isNil commit. The new equality check is inside that existing atomic mutation boundary.
implementation: Capture the preflight-admitted journal and compare it again before release/setup/OperationStart. Changed or missing data returns RESUME_LANES_CHANGED without consuming the durable order or renewing deadlines. Completed-room egress does not gain an unnecessary lane requirement. No payload schema, worker, retry, world query or native command change.
limits: This is one admission consistency guard, not the complete ordered snapshot/owner-ready contract. It relies on the existing producer replacing coherent lane snapshots rather than mutating their nested arrays in place. Later preparation/adoption, changed-roster migration, actor-local native acknowledgement, physical CQB flow and performance remain incomplete/unverified. Audits paused; no percentage increase or whole parity claim.
